title: Astrid and the Ember
author: Mirabel Ishikawa
blurb: Wendell Iversen, an exiled storm-caller, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
